source_binding.rule: Each baseline clone was placed at PARENT/mosaic because the Lua harness resolves include('mosaic/...') from that layout. Earlier clones with a different leaf name are excluded from evidence.

red.claim: Selected-step inspection must not borrow a later event, and H05/H06 must report the selected event's bypass, reason and fallback.

expected_failures: unknown selected step returned the latest event
empty selected step displayed NO RESULT instead of NO EVENT
local scale was labelled as a generic bypass
a healthy group member hid another member's local-scale bypass

red.claim: A reachable delayed arpeggio must consume Harmony history only at its actual emitted onset.

result.expected_failure: runtime.consumed was already populated immediately after step.handle, before any MIDI Note On

red.claim: A member-local octave override must retain its exact ordinary pitch and be exposed as a reason-specific local-octave bypass.

expected_failures: the playback inspection chain omitted the local_octave bypass classification
H05 rendered the generic BYPASS local_octave label instead of LOCAL OCTAVE BYPASS

public_behaviour.failure_workflow: Both real-time and controlled-experimental lanes passed reason-specific NO VOICING, NO EVENT selected-step inspection, strict silence and reason-specific Legacy fallback.
public_behaviour.ensemble_workflow: Both real-time and controlled-experimental lanes passed literal local-scale-bypass MIDI plus visible LOCAL SCALE BYPASS group status.
public_behaviour.qualification: The final exact-commit 16-run acceptance campaign is recorded separately in mosaic-ux-harmony-acceptance.json.
